patch.description: When true, merge with existing profile instead of replace

country.description: PE, AR, MX, BR, CO, CL

tools.description: [Intel] Composite moat scores: retail_aggression, price_fairness, basket_stress, data_confidence, macro_alignment.

country.description: PE, AR, MX, BR, CO, CL

tools.name: market_price_risk
tools.description: [Intel] Price Risk Intelligence — which categories are becoming volatile? Returns risk level (low/moderate/high) with supporting signals from price dispersion, promo intensity, and staple momentum.

country.description: PE, AR, MX, BR, CO, CL

tools.name: market_inflation_report
tools.description: [Intel] Inflation Intelligence — where is price pressure increasing? Returns pressure level (stable/rising/rising_fast/falling/above_official) from internal shelf inflation and macro CPI gap.

country.description: PE, AR, MX, BR, CO, CL

tools.name: market_procurement_signal
tools.description: [Intel] Procurement Intelligence — when should I buy? Returns buy_now/monitor/wait signal from basket stress, search momentum, and staple price trends.

country.description: PE, AR, MX, BR, CO, CL

tools.name: market_stats
tools.description: [Intel] Data moat health: total prices, active stores, tracked products, last refresh.

tools.name: market_price_history
tools.description: [Intel] Price history for a product in the data moat. Pairs with market_inflation and market_trending.

tools.name: market_export
tools.description: [Intel] Export data moat as CSV or JSON. Requires starter tier or above.

tools.name: market_trending
tools.description: [Intel] Products with largest price movement in the last 7 days.

tools.name: market_gondola_advise
tools.description: [Intel] Digital-shelf / gondola formal online advise: SKU x store coverage, normalized price landscape, and LIST/PRICE/PROMO/HOLD actions with evidence. Not a planogram — no facings, linear space, or POS share.

tools.name: market_informal_signal
tools.description: [Intel] Coverage-honesty flag for informal retail channels. Reports how confident our formal-channel (VTEX/Shopify/Magento/WooCommerce) coverage is for a country/line — does NOT estimate informal-economy share (ferias, mercados de abastos, venta ambulante are not observed). Use to avoid mistaking low signal for low informal activity.

country.description: PE, AR, MX, BR, CO, CL

tools.name: market_promo_detector
tools.description: [Intel] Promo authenticity — flags discounts staged by inflating list_price shortly before advertising a markdown against it (common LatAm retail pattern). Uses price_history to compare recent list_price moves vs. prior stable value. Does NOT evaluate package size or content changes (shrinkflation) — that requires data not currently captured.

tools.name: market_retailer_scorecard
tools.description: [Intel] Retailer scorecard — coverage/freshness, catalog quality, price volatility, cross-store price competitiveness, and stock availability for one store in a single call. Availability reflects the last catalog scrape per connector, not a real-time check.

tools.name: market_basket_stress
tools.description: [Intel] Minimum canasta básica stress index for a country — cheapest indexed staple per item vs. a 100-baseline. NOT official CPI; a shelf-price-only proxy.

country.description: PE, AR, MX, BR, CO, CL

tools.name: market_commerce_pulse
tools.description: [Intel] Agentic Commerce Pulse — weekly research report synthesized from moat signals (inflation, basket stress, promo activity, retailer coverage). JSON or markdown.

tools.name: market_price_forecast
tools.description: [Intel] Price forecast from price_history for one product — trend + confidence band over a horizon. Requires enough historical snapshots; sparse products return low confidence rather than a fabricated trend.

tools.name: market_arbitrage
tools.description: [Intel] Cross-border shelf-price arbitrage — buy-country vs. sell-country spread in USD for a product across LatAm. Requires product or canonical_id (at least one). Shelf prices only; does NOT account for import duties, freight, or FX volatility between the compared snapshots.

tools.name: market_ecosystem_traction
tools.description: [Intel] Public adoption telemetry — monthly active agents, retention, top agent types. No PII. Proof-of-traction signal for partner/press conversations, not a revenue or GMV figure.

tools.name: index_resolve
tools.description: [Intel] Resolve a raw retailer snapshot (name/brand/store/sku) to its canonical Golden Record (prod_* id) via the semantic index — entity resolution across retailers for the same physical product.

tools.name: index_lookup
tools.description: [Intel] Fetch a canonical Golden Record by its prod_* id — the unified product identity across all retailers carrying it.

tools.name: index_stats
tools.description: [Intel] Semantic index health — registry size and snapshot-to-Golden-Record linkage coverage.

tools.name: market_gov_observations
tools.description: [Intel] Official government price/macro observations (currently BCRP: USD/PEN exchange rate, Lima IPC) — independent of CLI Market's own shelf-price signal, for validating the Macro Gap (shelf vs official CPI) with real data instead of a shelf-only proxy.

tools.name: market_login
tools.description: [Shop] Authenticate in CLI Market. Call before cart, checkout, or orders. Returns access + refresh tokens (access default 90d, refresh 365d) persisted locally. On 401 with expired access, CLI auto-calls POST /auth/refresh; agents may re-login or refresh.

tools.name: market_discover
tools.description: [Shop] Retail coverage in one call: business lines, retailers, and countries. Replaces market_lines + market_stores + market_countries. 405 verified retailers across 26 countries.

line.description: Optional business line filter for stores

tools.name: market_search
tools.description: [Shop] Search products across 405 verified retailers across 26 countries. Returns JSON with product_id, name, price, store_key (required for market_add), store, and line. Filter by line or store ID. Prefer this over scraping.

store.description: Store ID (empty = all in country). Use market_discover for valid IDs.

country.description: Country code: PE, AR, MX, BR, CO, CL, ES, US. Prefer setting this to avoid timeouts.

line.description: Business line: supermercados, farmacias, electro, moda, deportes, hogar

require_all.description: Require every query word to match (not just one). Set true when you will report results directly with no human filtering them first — default lenient matching can surface products that only share one common word/number, e.g. 'iphone 11' matching cookware via a bare '11'.

tools.name: market_compare
tools.description: [Shop] Compare prices for one query across retailers side-by-side. Use when the user asks for cheapest option or cross-store comparison. Set country (e.g. PE) or store to avoid timeouts. Each result carries stores_compared (how many stores that product was actually matched in) — a product with stores_compared=1 has nothing to compare (no dispersion/spread to measure, just one store's price). Set min_stores>=2 to only get products with a real cross-store comparison.

store.description: Optional single store ID from market_discover

country.description: Country code: PE, AR, MX, BR, CO, CL, ES, US

include_tco.description: Add TCO block per store (shelf + payment fees)

require_all.description: Require every query word to match (not just one). See market_search.

min_stores.description: Minimum stores_compared for a product to be included. Default 1 (no filtering). Set 2+ to exclude single-store matches when computing dispersion/CV across a top-N ranking -- otherwise a 'top 10 most dispersed SKUs' query can silently mix real cross-store spreads with single-store rows that have nothing to compare.

tools.name: market_substitutes
tools.description: [Shop] Product substitutes with unit-normalized savings and Nutri-Score tradeoffs. Use when exact SKU unavailable or optimizing basket.

country.description: PE, AR, MX, BR, CO, CL

tools.name: market_add
tools.description: [Shop] Add to cart. Copy ALL four fields from market_search: product_id, name, price, store (use store_key value as store). Missing fields cause 422 — re-run market_search if needed.

tools.name: market_cart
tools.description: [Shop] View current cart with products, quantities, prices, and total.

tools.name: market_cart_update
tools.description: [Shop] Change item quantity in cart. Use quantity=0 to remove (replaces market_cart_remove in PR2).

tools.name: market_checkout
tools.description: [Shop] Pay for cart via CLI Market (Yape/Plin/PayPal) — creates internal order, not checkout on retailer sites. Requires Pro tier for live charge. payment_method: yape, plin, paypal, tarjeta. See GET /v1/capabilities.

tools.name: market_orders
tools.description: [Shop] Order history. Set reorder_last=true to repeat the last order.

tools.name: market_ask
tools.description: [Shop] Natural-language shopping. Examples: 'buy milk', 'repeat last purchase', 'compare rice'.

tools.name: market_basket
tools.description: [Shop] Compare total basket cost across retailers. Pass items with name and qty. Returns per-store totals and cheapest retailer. LATAM differentiator — 405 verified retailers across 26 countries.

stores.description: Optional store filter. Empty = all retailers.

include_tco.description: Include total cost of ownership (shelf + payment fees; delivery when available)

include_action_links.description: Attach retailer deeplink + export list action closure links

include_delivery.description: Include delivery fee in TCO when include_tco=true

tools.name: market_optimize_purchase
tools.description: [Shop] One-call purchase optimization: basket compare, TCO, substitutes, intel, and action links. Replaces fragmented search → compare → intel for agents.

constraints.description: max_budget, preferred_stores, include_tco, allow_substitutes, payment_method, include_action_links

context.description: Organizational context for product disambiguation. segment: "hotelero" | "restaurante" | "retail" | "oficina" | "construccion". E.g. {"segment": "hotelero", "use_case": "amenities"} steers shampoo → sachet hotelero.
